item.title: This couple took out an adjustable-rate mortgage when rates were over 8%. Here’s how it worked out.
item.description: Adjustable-rate mortgages have made a comeback as mortgage rates surge and buyers seek relief from high housing costs.
item.dc:creator: Aarthi Swaminathan

item.title: ‘Complete disruption of the economy is all but certain’: Top jobs and home prices are at risk, a new report on AI says
item.description: Job losses among screen-based workers and troubles for the housing market are among the challenges to the economy posed by AI, according to credit-ratings agency Egan-Jones.
item.dc:creator: Barbara Kollmeyer

item.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
item.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
item.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Tesla sold a lot more EVs than Wall Street expected, and the stock is surging
item.description: EV giant Tesla had the best three-month period for vehicle sales this year, but it was less than a year ago.
item.dc:creator: William Gavin

item.title: ‘I don’t want to die on the sales floor’: I’m 67 and earn $19.50 an hour at a big-box store. When can I finally retire?
item.description: “I started taking Social Security at 66 and receive $2,410 a month. I have $214,000 in my 401(k).”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
item.description: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Three reasons this Wall Street market-making powerhouse says investors should reload on stocks right now
item.description: September provided a stock-market reset, pointing to a good end to the year, says Scott Rubner of Citadel Securities.
item.dc:creator: Jamie Chisholm

item.title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
item.description: “Generally, the advice I’ve read says not to sell because I have a low-interest-rate mortgage.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: I’m 71 and still working. I earn $108,000 a year. Am I doing the right thing?
item.description: “I have $152,000 in my IRA and Roth accounts.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell
